tweets.text: "The men and women in this room come from different backgrounds and from all across our land – but each of you carries the same title that’s been proudly borne by patriots and pioneers, inventors and entrepreneurs – the title of American farmer."
tweets.text_resolved: "The men and women in this room come from different backgrounds and from all across our land – but each of you carries the same title that’s been proudly borne by patriots and pioneers, inventors and entrepreneurs – the title of American farmer."

tweets.text: "The American Dream is roaring back to life. And we have just signed into law the most significant tax cuts and reforms in American history "
tweets.text_resolved: "The American Dream is roaring back to life. And we have just signed into law the most significant tax cuts and reforms in American history "

tweets.text: "Small businesses will receive massive tax cuts. They will be able to deduct 20% of their business income. American farmers will be able to deduct 100% of the cost of new equipment in the year you make the investment."
tweets.text_resolved: "Small businesses will receive massive tax cuts. They will be able to deduct 20% of their business income. American farmers will be able to deduct 100% of the cost of new equipment in the year you make the investment."

tweets.text: "In every decision we make, we are honoring America’s proud farming legacy."
tweets.text_resolved: "In every decision we make, we are honoring America’s proud farming legacy."

tweets.text: "As we put money back in the pockets of all Americans—including our farmers and ranchers, we are also putting an end to the regulatory assault on your way of life."
tweets.text_resolved: "As we put money back in the pockets of all Americans—including our farmers and ranchers, we are also putting an end to the regulatory assault on your way of life."

tweets.text: "We are streamlining regulations that have blocked cutting edge biotechnology –setting free our farmers to innovate, thrive, and to grow... Because we know that our farmers are our future."
tweets.text_resolved: "We are streamlining regulations that have blocked cutting edge biotechnology –setting free our farmers to innovate, thrive, and to grow... Because we know that our farmers are our future."

tweets.text: "That is why today, in a few minutes, I will take the first step to expand access to broadband internet in rural America... I will sign two Presidential Orders to provide broader, faster – and better internet coverage."
tweets.text_resolved: "That is why today, in a few minutes, I will take the first step to expand access to broadband internet in rural America... I will sign two Presidential Orders to provide broader, faster – and better internet coverage."

tweets.text: "We see the promise of tomorrow in the incredible young farmers who have joined us today – students who are achieving incredible things through amazing organizations like FFA and 4-H."
tweets.text_resolved: "We see the promise of tomorrow in the incredible young farmers who have joined us today – students who are achieving incredible things through amazing organizations like FFA and 4-H."

tweets.text: "For America, there is no task too great, no goal too large, no dream beyond our reach. We are witnessing a new era of patriotism, prosperity and pride – and at the forefront of this exciting new chapter is the great American farmer."
